sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface binding assay in 384-well plates confirmed surface display of the NLuc-GPR182 fusion; ligand binding (the defining function of this atypical scavenging receptor) was measured and supported receptor activity.
sites.rationale: The paper (DOI:10.1101/2024.06.01.596940) reports a full-length, membrane-anchored NLuc–ACKR5 fusion that is surface-displayed and ligand-binding-competent in HEK293T cells. The topology has no signal peptide (O from residue 1), so 'N-terminally fused' maps unambiguously to a prepend before Met-1 (insert_after_residue = 0, residue_after = M). The extracellular N-terminal span (residues 1–53) is 53 residues long, providing ample room for a short epitope tag (~13–23 aa) well clear of the first TM helix boundary at residue 54. Full-length human ACKR5/GPR182 was N-terminally fused to Nanoluciferase and stably expressed in HEK293T cells (pIRES-puromycin vector); L2 confirms surface display via 384-well plate binding assays. No signal peptide is present in the topology (extracellular from residue 1), so exactly one extracellular N-terminus exists and the fusion necessarily precedes residue 1.

sources.claim: HEK293T cells stably expressing untagged human or mouse GPR182 (hGPR182 or mGPR182) or hCXCR4, hACKR3 or hGPR182 N-terminally fused to Nanoluciferase were established using pIRES-puromycin vectors and were grown in DMEM medium supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (Sigma) and penicillin/streptomycin (100 Units per ml and 100 μ g per ml) and puromycin (5 μ g per ml).

literature_notes: Only two ledger lines are provided (L1, L2); both describe the same NLuc N-terminal fusion construct of ACKR5/GPR182 and together constitute a single site. No ledger evidence supports any internal extracellular loop insertion (ECL1 111–123, ECL2 191–214, ECL3 282–296) or a C-terminal tag. The C-terminus (residues 324–404) is intracellular per the topology landmarks and is therefore not a surface-tag candidate. No residue number is named in either clip, so position_evidence is topology_derived rather than validated.
